div.head: II Atr 3.2
div.ab: Gyf he his scip upp getogen hæbbe oððon hulc geworhtne oððon geteld geslagen: þæt he ðær frið hæbbe ⁊ ealle his æhta.
Si nauem suam, extraxerit uel tuguriolum congerat uel papilionem tendat, habeat inibi pacem et tota pecunia sua.
Gyf he his scip upp getogen hæbbe oððon hulc geworhtne oððon geteld geslagen—þæt he ðær frið hæbbe ⁊ ealle his æhta.
If he has drawn his ship ashore or built a hut or pitched a tent, protection shall be afforded to himself and to all his goods.
Wenn er sein Schiff ans Land gezogen, oder [gesondert] eine Hütte aufgerichtet oder ein Zelt aufgeschlagen hat: dass er und alle seine Güter dort Friedensschutz geniesse [vor diesem Heere].
If he has drawn his ship up onto land, or put up a hut [separately], or pitched a tent: that he and all his goods have protection there [from this army].
